title: GitHub
description:
GitHub describes the access to a commit of a GitHub repository, downloadable
as an archive via the GitHub REST API.

The canonical type is "GitHub" (brand casing). The lowercase "github" and
camelCase "gitHub" spellings used by old OCM
(https://github.com/open-component-model/ocm/blob/main/api/ocm/extensions/accessmethods/github/method.go)
and the OCM spec are retained as deprecated aliases so existing component
descriptors keep resolving.

apiHostname.description: APIHostname overrides the GitHub REST API hostname for GitHub Enterprise.

commit.description:
Commit is the 40-hex-character SHA of the commit to access. Required, so
the content an access points at never changes.

ref.description:
Ref is the git reference (e.g. refs/heads/main) the Commit came from.
Optional and informational.

repoUrl.description: RepoURL is the full repository URL (e.g. https://github.com/open-component-model/ocm).
